parsed.rationale: Both participating records are test/mock fixtures. The first record, `ObservationTestMockPlayer`, resides in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/ObservationIntegrationTests.swift` (a test file), and the second, `MockAudioPlayer`, resides in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/MockAudioPlayer.swift` (explicitly under a `Mocks/` directory). Per the decision rules, any cluster where a participating record is a mock or test fixture warrants no-action, and here both records carry that character. Consolidating or lifting these types would couple test-only mock semantics together without production benefit, and the structural overlap is expected given that both types are purpose-built to stand in for the same audio-player interface under test.
